Book an Appointment Call 01773 824 114 Cam belt replacement Belper A cambelt, often referred to as a timing belt, plays a critical role in the operation of your car's engine. It synchronises the movement of the crankshaft and camshaft, ensuring that the engine's valves open and close at the correct time. If a cambelt fails, it can cause severe engine damage. The pistons may collide with the valves, leading to costly repairs or even engine replacement. To prevent such catastrophic outcomes, it's essential to follow your vehicle manufacturer's recommended cambelt replacement schedule. Even with proper care, cambelts can wear out over time. Regular servicing helps identify potential problems early on, preventing more serious issues and costly repairs. Don't risk engine damage. Contact us to schedule a comprehensive cambelt inspection and replacement. Our experienced technicians will ensure your vehicle's engine operates smoothly and efficiently. Our professional DPF cleaning service can breathe new life into your engine. We utilise advanced technology to remove harmful soot and contaminants from your DPF, restoring peak performance and efficiency. This is crucial for maintaining optimal engine health and ensuring compliance with emissions regulations. Our meticulous process includes a thorough inspection and the application of a specialised cleaning solution that effectively dissolves soot and deposits. This not only restores the DPF's functionality but also helps prevent future clogging. By choosing our DPF cleaning service, you can avoid costly repairs and downtime associated with DPF replacements. Schedule an appointment today and experience the difference a clean DPF can make. Book an Appointment Call 01773 824 114 Hybrid EV Servicing Belper Maintaining a hybrid vehicle is similar to caring for a traditional car, but with a few key differences. Our experienced technicians are here to handle all your hybrid's maintenance needs, from routine fluid changes and tyre rotations to specialised checks for the inverter coolant, charging point, and battery. We'll meticulously inspect the inverter coolant, a crucial component that regulates the electric motor's temperature. A malfunctioning inverter coolant pump can lead to overheating or undercooling, damaging the motor. We'll also examine the charging point and cable for any signs of wear or damage, ensuring your hybrid charges efficiently. Schedule your hybrid service today and let our skilled technicians take care of your vehicle. We use the latest diagnostic equipment and follow manufacturer guidelines to ensure your hybrid receives the best possible care. Our dedication to excellence means your vehicle will remain in top condition for years to come. Book an Appointment Call 01773 824 114 Cam belt replacement Belper A cambelt, often referred to as a timing belt, plays a critical role in the operation of your car's engine. It synchronises the movement of the crankshaft and camshaft, ensuring that the engine's valves open and close at the correct time. If a cambelt fails, it can cause severe engine damage. The pistons may collide with the valves, leading to costly repairs or even engine replacement. To prevent such catastrophic outcomes, it's essential to follow your vehicle manufacturer's recommended cambelt replacement schedule. Even with proper care, cambelts can wear out over time. Regular servicing helps identify potential problems early on, preventing more serious issues and costly repairs. Don't risk engine damage. We'll meticulously inspect the inverter coolant, a crucial component that regulates the electric motor's temperature. A malfunctioning inverter coolant pump can lead to overheating or undercooling, damaging the motor. We'll also examine the charging point and cable for any signs of wear or damage, ensuring your hybrid charges efficiently.
